title: 最大兼容性评分和
summary: 把学生与导师一一配对，兼容分为问卷相同答案数，求总兼容分最大值。
insight: 先算所有学生导师配对分数。用掩码表示已使用导师，当前学生下标等于掩码置位数，枚举未使用导师并记忆最大剩余得分。
pitfalls: 每名导师只能匹配一次
问卷答案相同才得一分
人数最多八适合位压缩

solutions.title: 状态压缩配对 DP
solutions.idea: 对已用导师集合求剩余学生最优匹配。
steps: 枚举 mask 中未用 mentor，取 score+dfs(newMask) 最大并记忆

code.java: class Solution { int[][] score;int[] memo;private int dfs(int mask){if(mask==memo.length-1)return 0;if(memo[mask]>=0)return memo[mask];int student=Integer.bitCount(mask),best=0;for(int mentor=0;mentor<score.length;mentor++)if((mask&(1<<mentor))==0)best=Math.max(best,score[student][mentor]+dfs(mask|1<<mentor));return memo[mask]=best;}public int maxCompatibilitySum(int[][] students,int[][] mentors){int n=students.length;score=new int[n][n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=0;j<n;j++)for(int q=0;q<students[i].length;q++)if(students[i][q]==mentors[j][q])score[i][j]++;memo=new int[1<<n];Arrays.fill(memo,-1);return dfs(0);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var score:Array<IntArray>;private lateinit var memo:IntArray;private fun dfs(mask:Int):Int{if(mask==memo.lastIndex)return 0;if(memo[mask]>=0)return memo[mask];val student=Integer.bitCount(mask);var best=0;for(mentor in score.indices)if(mask and (1 shl mentor)==0)best=maxOf(best,score[student][mentor]+dfs(mask or (1 shl mentor)));memo[mask]=best;return best};fun maxCompatibilitySum(students:Array<IntArray>,mentors:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=students.size;score=Array(n){student->IntArray(n){mentor->students[student].indices.count{students[student][it]==mentors[mentor][it]}}};memo=IntArray(1 shl n){-1};return dfs(0)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<vector<int>> score;vector<int> memo;int dfs(int mask){if(mask==(int)memo.size()-1)return 0;int& result=memo[mask];if(result>=0)return result;int student=__builtin_popcount((unsigned)mask);result=0;for(int mentor=0;mentor<(int)score.size();++mentor)if(!(mask&(1<<mentor)))result=max(result,score[student][mentor]+dfs(mask|(1<<mentor)));return result;}public: int maxCompatibilitySum(vector<vector<int>>& students,vector<vector<int>>& mentors){int n=students.size();score.assign(n,vector<int>(n));for(int i=0;i<n;++i)for(int j=0;j<n;++j)for(int q=0;q<(int)students[i].size();++q)score[i][j]+=students[i][q]==mentors[j][q];memo.assign(1<<n,-1);return dfs(0);} };
